message.content:
Here’s how you would query VirusTotal for the graph IDs that contain the IP address **145.34.45.56**, using `api_key_2`, setting the pagination cursor to `'cursor_b'` and limiting the response to eight items:

```http
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/graphs/ip/145.34.45.56.json?
    apiKey=api_key_2&
    cursor=cursor_b&
    limit=8
```

**Explanation**

| Parameter   | Value          |
|-------------|----------------|
| `apiKey`    | `api_key_2` – your second API key |
| `ipAddress` | `145.34.45.56` – the target IP |
| `cursor`    | `cursor_b` – tells VT where to start returning data |
| `limit`     | `8` – maximum number of graph‑ID entries returned |

When you send this HTTP GET request, VirusTotal will return up to eight graph ID objects that reference the given IP address, starting at the position indicated by `cursor_b`.
